rows.note: Use 請 as the everyday all-purpose verb for taking someone on as an employee.

example.english: The company will employ a new accountant, who will start work next month.
example.traditional: 間公司請咗個新會計，佢下個月返工。
example.jyutping: gaan1 gung1 si1 ceng2 zo2 go3 san1 wui6 gai3 keoi5 haa6 go3 jyut6 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use 用 when employing a person or tool to accomplish a particular task rather than hiring someone.

example.english: We employ an experienced electrician for this job.
example.traditional: 呢份工程我哋用熟手電工嚟做。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 gung1 cing4 ngo5 dei6 jung6 suk6 sau2 din6 gung1 lai4 zou6

rows.note: Use this when keeping someone occupied by finding something for them to do.

example.english: I employ the child by finding things for him to do, so he does not run around.
example.traditional: 我成日搵嘢畀個細路做，等佢唔好周圍走。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 wan2 je5 bei2 go3 sai3 lou6 zou6 dang2 keoi5 m4 hou2 zau1 wai4 zau2
